_comment: Concept glossary for the Omniscol semantic translation pipeline (V2). Built from data/source/Glossary.md plus confirmed French terms found in data/source/fr_webapp.json. Each concept lists surface forms per language and the confusions that must never collapse together.

teacher.meaning: A teacher user/role, distinct from generic staff and from 'head teacher' (role.main_teacher)

head_teacher.meaning: role.main_teacher: the homeroom/class tutor, NOT the school's head/director

student.meaning: A learner enrolled in a class

class.meaning: The overall student cohort/grade grouping (class.*), distinct from a single scheduled lesson (sched.course.*) and from a sub-group (group.*)

lesson.meaning: sched.course.*: a single scheduled teaching session/slot, distinct from the 'class' cohort and from 'subject'

subject.meaning: subject.*: the academic discipline (e.g. Maths), distinct from a scheduled lesson

group.meaning: group.*: a subdivision used to split or align students within/across classes, distinct from the whole 'class'

classroom.meaning: classroom.*: a physical room resource, distinct from the broader 'resource' concept

resource.meaning: Any schedulable resource (equipment, room, staffing) - broader than 'classroom'; e.g. sched.course.assign_resources

absence.meaning: absence.*: a recorded non-attendance event, distinct from a scheduling 'conflict'

conflict.meaning: A scheduling collision between two resources/entities in the generated timetable

preferences.meaning: teacher.wishes.*: stated, non-binding scheduling wishes of a teacher

hours_distribution.meaning: teacher.assignedhours / teacher.distributedhours: allocation of teaching hours

partition.meaning: group.timeset: a group defined by splitting a class into a time-based partition

alignment.meaning: group.spaceset: a group synchronised in time with another so students can move between sessions

activate.meaning: action.activate: turn an account/feature ON from a disabled/inactive lifecycle state (e.g. activating a new user account)

enable.meaning: action.enable: toggle an already-existing feature/setting on, distinct lifecycle stage from account 'activation'. Currently mistranslated identically to 'activate' in Polish (both -> 'Aktywuj') - flagged by the audit.

director.meaning: role.director: the school's head/director, NOT the 'head teacher' (professeur principal / class tutor)
